d: Are you the kind of person who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving puzzles, and keeps things moving smoothly behind the scenes? If managing daily warehouse operations and optimizing workflows sounds like your jam, we want you on our squad!
At Boutiqaat, our warehouse is where the magic begins, and we’re looking for an Operations Officer who can ensure everything runs like clockwork.
If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, lead with precision, and think three steps ahead, you could be the operations maestro we need!
q: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business Admin, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or e-commerce operations.
Proven skills with ERP/WMS systems and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
Fluent in English (Arabic is a plus).
Hands-on experience leading teams and solving operational puzzles on the fly.
Ability to stay cool under pressure and even cooler when things go right.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Coordinate daily warehouse activities to guarantee timely and accurate order fulfillment
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with procurement to keep shelves stocked
Supervise receiving, storage, and dispatching goods with a keen eye for detail
Implement and improve operational procedures to boost efficiency and safety
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including logistics, supply chain, and customer service
Lead and motivate warehouse staff to achieve daily targets and uphold quality standards
Ensure compliance with health, safety, and security regulations
Analyze data and generate reports to identify trends and improve performance.
